=== mew renderer torture sample =========================
Dense mix of the classes that broke rendering: C0 and C1
controls, marks from scripts mew cannot render, marks on a
base of the wrong script, marks with no base, invalid UTF-8.
No row may overrun its window, lose text, or drift the caret.
